question: What protection is gained by bathing there and worshipping the liṅga?
premises: Bathing and worship are performed at the site
The liṅga is the object of worship
A specific fear associated with the sun is avoided
inference: One who bathes there and worships the liṅga does not incur fear of the sun
uncertainties: bhāskarī+bhayam may refer to fear from the sun or a related affliction; exact sense unclear
plain_english: Having bathed there, one should worship the liṅga and does not go to fear of the sun.
